strings.pwa_install_manual: Complete installation through your browser menu.
strings.pwa_install_prompting: Confirm installation in the browser window.
strings.pwa_install_accepted: The browser accepted your request. Follow its steps to finish installation.
strings.pwa_install_dismissed: Installation cancelled. You can try again through the browser menu.
strings.pwa_install_error: The browser could not open installation. Use the steps below.
strings.pwa_install_installed: ULADIM is installed on this device.
strings.pwa_install_ios: Tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Then open ULADIM from the new icon.

strings.pwa_install_mac: In Safari, open Share → Add to Dock → Add.
strings.pwa_install_desktop: Use the install icon beside the address bar or the browser menu → Install ULADIM.
strings.pwa_install_unavailable: If installation is unavailable, open ULADIM in a current Chrome, Edge or Safari browser. You can keep using this tab.
strings.control_directory_help: Accounts, names supplied by users, and access status. Personal records stay private.
strings.control_empty_users: No accounts match. Try another search.
strings.control_optional_name: Name supplied by the account owner
strings.control_cases_help: Help with sign-in and deleted records. Always select the original account separately from the person contacting support.
strings.control_choose_original: Find and select the original account. The ticket author is never selected automatically.
strings.control_empty_cases: No matching cases yet. Start from an account, a ticket, or a manual contact.
strings.control_cross_account: The ticket was sent from a different account. It does not prove ownership of the selected original account.
strings.control_owner_steps: The owner must sign into the original account and confirm the case in the app. For records, the owner selects items in Trash and gives separate consent.
strings.control_send_original: Send a reset email to the original address
strings.control_reset_help: The email goes only to the selected account’s stored verified address. Staff receive no password or code; MFA stays enabled.
strings.control_mail_requested: Email requested. Only the owner can continue recovery.
strings.control_close_help: This changes the case status. It does not grant record restoration.
strings.control_no_owner_requests: The owner has not submitted a matching record recovery request yet. Wait for the owner to select records and consent from the original account.
strings.control_requests_help: Staff review only metadata and consent. The owner completes restoration in their own account.
strings.control_approval_help: Consent applies to the selected record version. Staff cannot see its content; the owner restores it.
strings.control_approved_help: Request approved. The account owner will restore the record.
strings.control_team_help: Roles set the maximum permissions. Additional restrictions can only remove actions. Every staff member needs MFA.
strings.control_role_owner_help: Manages the system and the team. Owner permissions cannot be changed here.
strings.control_role_admin_help: Manages operations and lower-ranked staff within their own permissions.
strings.control_role_support_help: Helps with sign-in, support tickets, and consented record recovery.
strings.control_role_moderator_help: Handles tickets and applies temporary restrictions.
strings.control_role_billing_manager_help: Reviews accounts and manages manual access grants; does not create payments.
strings.control_role_auditor_help: Views metrics and the activity log.
strings.control_restriction_help: A checked action is allowed within the role. Uncheck it to restrict the staff member. You cannot delegate permissions you do not have.
strings.control_role_ceiling: Unavailable for the selected roles or your authority
strings.control_lower_only: Only lower-ranked staff can be edited. You cannot edit your own permissions or the owner here.
strings.control_save_sessions_help: After saving, this staff member must sign into Control again. The reason is recorded in the audit log.
strings.control_invite_help: Share the one-use code only with the intended recipient through a secure channel. They must sign into their verified account and set up MFA. It expires in 24 hours.
strings.control_settings_help: Changes apply to the web app. Review the proposed values before saving.
strings.control_compact_onboarding_help: Shortens the getting-started screen for accounts without a workspace.
strings.control_chart_styles_help: Adds chart style selection in Finance. When disabled, the standard style is used.
strings.control_support_entry_help: Adds a support shortcut to the header. The regular Profile route remains available.
strings.control_rollout_help: The percentage selects a stable group of accounts. 0% means nobody; 100% means everyone. When disabled, nobody receives the change.
strings.control_proposal_help: The proposal expires in 10 minutes. The change is saved only after confirmation.
strings.control_newcomers_help: Future verified accounts receive a welcome at their first eligible signed-in app open. No account IDs are needed. One welcome per account.
strings.control_future_users: Future users. 0 recipients now is expected; new accounts become eligible after publication.
strings.control_no_expiry_help: For new users, the message stays active until stopped. You can schedule its start time.
strings.control_snapshot_help: For existing accounts, recipients are fixed at publication. Future registrations are excluded.
strings.control_stale: The data changed. Return to the list and open the latest version before trying again.
strings.control_not_configured: This change is not configured yet
strings.web_feedback_identity_hint: Visible to support. Leave empty to remove; workspace profiles keep their names.
strings.web_feedback_identity_error: Could not load your display name. Retry.
strings.web_feedback_case_intro: Confirm that this is your original account. Record contents stay private.
strings.web_feedback_case_consent: This confirmation does not allow staff to read or restore records. In Trash, choose a record and send its separate recovery request.
strings.web_feedback_case_access: You are signed in to the original account. Support can send password reset mail to its verified address. MFA stays enabled.
strings.web_feedback_case_unavailable: This case is unavailable for this account.
